name: 记账管家
tagline: A private ledger fed by typing, receipt photos or voice notes
description: Record spending however it arrives: a typed line, a photo of the receipt or bill, or a spoken note. Entries land in a CSV kept on your own device, with a Feishu or Lark bitable offered as an optional sync if you want the ledger elsewhere too.
author: cgnot996
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
